about.text:
VoxVault — a free speech recognition application.

Why use it:
• Completely free: no subscription, payment or ads.
• Privacy: recordings and texts stay on your computer.
• Works offline: no cloud and no data sent to the internet.
• Supports many interface languages and recognition models.

Author: Makeenak Alyaksandr
6836808@gmail.com
